_comment: Post-bump 27B quality acceptance (MEN17). Radiance 2.2 retired MXFP4: the subject is now upstream's IQ8R container (StillDeadcode/qwen3.8-27b-iq8r-dflash, sha256 9388f4c0d1a050b1254f5a9c0e47b7fbf753248792a29b5072f9698957badfcc) with the i8 KV cache that upstream pairs with it, on the two XTX (tp 2, exact wire). Arms differ in kernels.attn_native / kernels.moe_native as before. NOT MIGRATED to the native-YAML start: this job format names a layout plus bc-serve --set keys (arm.serving.layout, serving.set), and a managed v3 start takes no --set; the arms need a job format that names a native config file (as tools/lab/radiance/arm_yaml.py writes). Its record args are the engine's own flags and are migrated. The first 1.7.0 evidence (MXFP4: attn-native KLD 0.0040, top-1 96.6%) is history and not comparable. Set RAD_BIN, RAD_HOME, KLD_REF_DIR before use. Not used by tests.
